lore_anchors.definition: A breakthrough in comprehending Heartforce, the rarest cultivation power in Desolate Era, based on sincere Dao-heart and will. Considered far more dangerous than a typical cultivation realm advancement.
A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals, manifesting a temporary divine spirit of god-tier durability. Ji Ning leads this formation.
A metaphysical luck resource accumulated by factions. Both sides fight proxy wars to steal each other's Qi before the final battle.
A full-scale war for control of an entire major world, drawing in most Empyrean Gods and True Immortals from a realm.
A fruit of condensed Chaos Force created by a True God or Daofather sacrificing a permanent sliver of their comprehension of Chaos. A legendary cultivation resource.
A battle formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, manifesting as a massive dragon-like creature.
The advanced stage of True Immortal where the Golden Core is purified to Pure Yang. A major milestone in Ki Refining.
